bullets.text: AI Accelerator Unveiled - **Microsoft** introduces Maia 200, enhancing AI token generation efficiency with groundbreaking performance.
Government Cyber Defense Insights - **Microsoft** emphasizes proactive strategies to combat evolving cyber threats targeting government entities.
GitHub Copilot SDK Launched - **Microsoft** enhances developer productivity by embedding work context into coding with the new SDK.
Securing AI Agents - **Microsoft Defender** introduces real-time protection for AI agents, addressing unique security challenges.
Windows 365 for AI Agents - **Microsoft** expands Windows 365 capabilities, enabling secure operation of AI agents on Cloud PCs.
Windows App Development CLI - **Microsoft** announces winapp, simplifying Windows app development across various frameworks.
Integrated Security Success - **Microsoft** showcases how integrated security is essential for AI transformation in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - **Microsoft** rolls out updates for Notepad and Paint, enhancing user experience for Insiders.
Xbox App on Arm PCs - **Microsoft** expands gaming access by launching the Xbox app on Arm-based Windows 11 PCs.
AI Agents Security Posture - **Microsoft** outlines the importance of securing AI agents in a rapidly evolving threat landscape.
